title: Efficient federated-learning model training in wireless communication system

pse.problem: Inefficient federated-learning model training in wireless communication systems due to large amounts of model parameter data exchanged between distributed nodes (DTHs) and centralized nodes (MTH), consuming network resources.
pse.solution_function: Efficient model aggregation by minimizing the amount of model parameter data transferred from DTHs to MTH in each round, reducing resource consumption.
pse.solution_structure: Distributed Training Hosts (DTHs) and Meta Training Host (MTH). DTHs perform local model training on their individual data sets. MTH aggregates model parameters from multiple DTHs to generate a global model.
pse.solution_implementation: Each round of model collection, DTHs transfer local model parameters to the MTH instead of raw training data. The MTH combines these parameters to update the global model, which is then fed back to DTHs for further iterations until convergence.
pse.effect: Reduced network resource consumption during federated-learning model training in wireless communication systems
